title: SWE-2
lede: September 10, 2026. The first SWE model post-trained on a multi-trillion-parameter base — Kimi K3 under the hood, Cognition's refined RL recipe on top — and the first coding model to sit within a single point of the frontier while costing roughly a third as much to run.
body:
h2. THE HEADLINE

table(statrow).
|50.0%|−64%|92.8%|
|frontiercode 1.1 main|cost vs fable 5.1|terminal-bench 2.1|

p. *50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main* — within one point of Fable 5.1, at 64% lower rollout cost. Within a few points of GPT-6 Astra at roughly a quarter of the price. Ahead of its own predecessor SWE-1.7, Grok 4.6, and GPT-5.6 Sol on the comparison table Cognition published. And *92.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.1* — the top of that board.

h2. HOW IT WAS TRAINED

* %(cyan)Base% — Kimi K3: the recipe ported onto open weights at multi-trillion-parameter scale.
* %(cyan)Recipe% — a refinement of the multi-turn RL stack proven on Kevin-32B, SWE-1.5→1.7, scaled to a frontier-size base for the first time.
* %(cyan)Objective% — jointly optimize capability %(amber)and% cost; the Pareto curve is the target, not a single score.

h2. EFFORT LEVELS — A FIRST FOR THE FAMILY

table(specs).
|_. effort|_. behavior|
|Medium|scores higher than SWE-1.7 while taking *58% fewer turns* and costing *81% less*|
|High|more thinking for harder problems|
|Max|learned to spend more tokens and turns to reach the highest scores|

p. The small detail the curators love: on medium effort, SWE-2 makes its %(hl)first code edit at step 18% where SWE-1.7 waited until step 48 — it explores more deliberately, then commits. Intelligence, in this lineage, is partly the discipline not to touch the keyboard.

h2. WHERE IT LIVES

table(specs).
|_. surface|_. status at launch|
|Devin Desktop|%(ok)available day one%|
|Devin CLI|%(ok)available day one%|
|Devin Web|rolling out|
|Fusion|rolling out|

p. Launch terms: free for Pro, Max, and Teams subscribers for the first month. Benchmark disclosure note, per the lab: each model evaluated in its native harness — Claude Code for Anthropic models, Codex for OpenAI, Grok Build for xAI, Devin CLI for open weights — best score across effort settings.

bq. Our team uses SWE-2 daily in Devin for feature development, debugging, and complex visualizations. %(dim)— Cognition, September 2026 — the flagship eats its own cooking%
